chunks: And from him, from Abu Talib al-Anbari, who said: He informed me, Ali ibn Muhammad, that Muhammad ibn al-Abbas narrated to them from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Hanan ibn Sadir, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Hanan, when it is the Day of Arafah, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, looks upon the visitors of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and says to them: 'Begin anew, for you have been forgiven.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husayn on the Day of Arafah?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reveals the unique intercessory power of Imam al-Husayn’s shrine, where Allah’s gaze upon visitors on the Day of Arafah signifies a direct, unconditional grant of forgiveness. This event underscores the Shia theological concept of *tawassul* through the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the pilgrimage to the shrine with the spiritual renewal (*istinaf*) celebrated during the major Eid of the Ahl al-Bayt.
